method: Codex in-app browser; visible controls and DOM-backed reads; local HTTP; fixed prototype data
scope: Independent HTML only. This is a consolidated observation record, not an automatic product test runner log.

observations.observed: Ordinary chat, enqueue and two completed outputs retain the original source. New result does not replace source. Chat switching keeps independent bindings.
Clear command followed immediately by ordinary text clears the source without a false image revision conflict. Artwork remains. Undo restores the binding.
Clicking × removes source and refreshes current creation; six existing sample artworks remain.
Discussion disables and clears generation participation. Explicit chat opt-in enables color reference participation. Changing color to composition resets participation to false.
Typing a new text draft does not conflict with the image-purpose patch and draft text remains. Receipt undo restores discussion use.
Operation command stays independently queued, has no immediate-steer action and displays prototype scope. Stopping current reply pauses subsequent messages; queued command can be cancelled.
Restoring a cancelled message preserves an existing new draft and reports the conflict instead of overwriting it.
The second plain-text message is consumed once at a safe point of the active reply; observed final text says no second concurrent response was started.
After sending a reference-change-then-generate command, switching the model does not replace the command's original configuration in its preview.

observations.scenario: Preset switch and explicit new-chat default
observations.observed: Disabling preset retains its selection. Saving disabled as new-chat default is inherited by a new chat while an existing chat remains enabled. Shared edit lists affected chats and enabled states before saving a new revision.
Setting current discussion proposal to revision 2 leaves explicitly prepared revision 1 preview valid and confirm enabled.
Removing source disables confirmation with a stale-input explanation. Re-preview excludes source and enables confirmation.
Final storage namespace restores queued task paused with submission count 0. Manual continue changes immediately to running and count 1.
Restored task requires verification; submission count stays 1 and no automatic resend occurs. Verification can report confirmed cancellation.
Local cancellation details show before-submit and count 0. Final card label after refresh is 已取消 · 未发送.
Confirmed cancellation preserves the existing result and shows partial completion.

Default range is current batch (three). Landscape and portrait are complete, with 760×460 and 460×760 labels. Fit/zoom work; last next action disables, focus has an enabled previous action. Switching to creation range preserves current artwork identity (3 of 6). Seeds are explicitly mock values.
At 800×900, page width is 800; one visible chat entry and one creation entry. Both drawers open. Toast bottom 685.60 is above input top 727.20; send bottom 835.70 remains in viewport.
Checked warning/error logs are empty in test and showcase tabs. Set-current action is reflected in the creation panel.

Final visible native anchor has .svg download filename and image/svg+xml data URI. Its decoded SVG payload was saved as inspection evidence. Download-event wait and downloadMedia timed out without a saved-file receipt.

intermediateObservations: One undo click showed no immediate change; repeating through the exact receipt control succeeded. No speculative patch was made for that single observation.
A later running-task count lookup occurred after completion and removal from active list; the valid immediate post-resume observation was count 1.
An early cross-version reload used the previous storage key. Restart tests were repeated in the final independent storage namespace.
Process screenshots can precede final model-label and native-download-link cleanup; desktop-final.jpg captures the final interface.
